stop_bleed.label: Prevent new failures
stop_bleed.meaning: Fix the point of entry so new records stop failing: make the field mandatory, add validation, fix the interface, retrain.

backfill.label: Backfill under control
backfill.meaning: Correct existing records where the source system permits it, under its own procedure.

accept.label: Accept
accept.meaning: Record that the remaining records will not be corrected, with reason, approver and review date.

fix_load.label: Fix the load
fix_load.meaning: Change the pipeline so the platform generates or keeps the value.

fix_check.label: Fix or re-scope the check
fix_check.meaning: The check is wrong or too broad; the Rules team changes or scopes it.

impactScore: tier weight (3/2/1) × field criticality (1.5 if any CDE) × (1 + sqrt(open + recent + new)/10) × (1 + days past target/30). Historical volume excluded by design.

nextSteps.raised: The owner receives the request with the fields and sample records, and accepts or declines it.
nextSteps.accepted: The owner makes the change under their own change control; the Hub reads the date it goes live.
nextSteps.live: The checks confirm it: no new failures for the required number of checks, and the backlog clears or is accepted.
nextSteps.declined: The trustee re-plans: a different action, a different owner, or acceptance with a reason.

planForNote: Levers vary by table kind: reference tables drop backfill unless the cause is a missing master record or missing validation; legacy migration on reference data is accept-only; SAP BW interface issues go to the load.

fromWorkbook: check definitions, plain names, what-it-checks and what-a-failure-means text
derived: field display names (dictionary — editable in the Field names sheet)
tier (assumed from the product list — confirm with the register)
root cause and plan (deterministic mapping from signals)
simulated: every failing count and weekly history
provenance.rule: Production shows nothing in the simulated list unless it comes from the ledger, the registry or a channel; the narration sentence is a template over the signals and is labelled as such.
